title: The Hat Pack (wh)
description: A pvp resource pack created for Hathats93. Best used for mace gamemodes like Spear Mace and Regular Mace
body:
## The Best Minecraft PvP Texture Pack (No Bias At All)

This pack is created for the Ultimate experience for Minecraft PvP. The mace has been changed to the windhammer for a better look. And additions to aid in your pvp.

Additions:
- Low Shield
- Small items (Food, XP bottles, etc.)
- Small Totem
- Bright Cobwebs
- Bow Charger Level Indicator
- Smaller But Still Vanilla Swords 
- Custom Red Netherite Items
- Windhammer maces 
- Unobtrusive Particles
- Fire Crit Particlees
- Transparent Potion Particles
- Unobtrusive Bobber
- And More!

Please Report any issues in my discord server
